china-1922:p0908_1.rationale: Roster of Chinese Maritime Customs staff by Inspectorate General and treaty port, with predominantly foreign officers; an office-holder list of administrative personnel. The foreign-staffed customs service supports informal-imperialism, but no tag fits that specifically.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for foreign-staffed Chinese customs administration (informal-imperialism)?

china-1922:p0913_1.rationale: Roster of foreign staff of the Salt Revenue Administration by section and district, with posts. Textual office-holder list.

china-1922:p0914_1.rationale: Continuation of the Salt Revenue Administration staff list by district and auditorate, with names and posts only.

china-1922:p0914_2.rationale: Roster of Postal Administration staff by Directorate General department and provincial district, giving names and posts. Textual office-holder list.

china-1922:p1000_1.rationale: List of British diplomatic and consular officers in China by place, rank, name and appointment date. Dates are incidental, so the content is textual.

china-1922:p1002_1.rationale: Roster of foreign legation and consulate staff in China by country, place and post. Names and posts only.

china-1922:p1008_1.rationale: List of Chinese orders of merit and decorations with classes and grade remarks. Descriptive text, no quantities.

china-1922:p1009_1.rationale: Republican commemoration days with dates and the events commemorated. Textual list of a few events across political history, but not a general chronology.
review_questions: Is a tag needed for public holidays or commemorations?

china-1922:p1009_2.rationale: Place list of Chinese Chambers of Commerce abroad: commercial organisations that also reflect overseas Chinese communities. Textual list of places only.

china-1922:p1009_3.rationale: Office-bearers and committee of the British Chamber of Commerce at Shanghai, with names and affiliated firms. Textual roster.
